description: Free, open-source network vulnerability scanner that ranks findings by real-world exploitability (EPSS + CISA KEV). Windows, macOS, Linux. No cloud, no telemetry. MIT.
long:
ShadowSecurityScanner v1.5.7 is out.

What's new:
• Add a network (CIDR or range) as one entry and scan it whole
• Import networks from CSV as one entry each, listing refused rows by line

Free, open-source network vulnerability scanner that ranks findings by real-world exploitability (FIRST.org EPSS + CISA KEV). Single desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux — no cloud, no telemetry, MIT-licensed.

Full changelog: https://shadowsecurityscanner.com/changelog/#v1.5.7
short: ShadowSecurityScanner v1.5.7 is out — free, open-source vuln scanner with EPSS + CISA KEV prioritisation.
